# Onboarding Revamp

- **Goal / definition of done:** cut time-to-first-value for new customers from 9 days to under
  2 days with a self-serve onboarding funnel, by **2026-10-01**.
- **Owner:** [Sam Okafor](../people/sam-okafor.md) (Eng) with [Priya Nair](../people/priya-nair.md)
  (Product).
- **Status:** **on track.** Beta funnel live with a cohort of new signups.
- **Dependency:** identity/SSO provisioning from [Kevin Zhang](../people/kevin-zhang.md) for the
  enterprise self-serve path.

## Open items
- Accessibility review (Priya treats a11y regressions as launch-blockers).
- Instrumentation for activation metrics owed by Nadia's data team.
